messages.subject: Summer meetings: Wednesdays 1-3
parts:
Hi all,

The votes are in and our meeting time for the summer session will be Wednesdays 1-3.  We'll have our first meeting this Wednesday in Wickson 2124.

There will be no speakers over the summer term, just co-work and mutual help in R and related topics (including shell/git topics covered in the SWC workshop).  However, if you'd like to present work of yours for feedback, that will be welcome.  Just let me know the week beforehand.

And there will be cookies.

Noam

Hi y'all,

Apologies to anyone who showed up at 1 o'clock today.  I got my schedule mixed up and thought that D-RUG was 3-5. We'll return to 1-3PM next week.

Noam
